description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the {html_checkboxes} function, which generates HTML checkbox input elements based on provided parameters. It includes functions for rendering checkboxes and handling their output, with support for options, values, and customization.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes
methods.description: Generates a list of HTML checkbox inputs based on parameters, options, and values.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes_output
methods.description: Creates the HTML for a single checkbox input with label and separator.
